prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory-only,human approval,no autonomous dispatch/control/release. Actors: local fire agencies,county emergency management,state wildland fire resources,aviation support units,cooperating public safety partners,command/maintenance staff. Caldera Incident Command Portal(Emberhall): Duty Detection Officer(Orion) reviews Thermal Spot Snippet/dispositions. Confirmed Ignition State requires persistence+independent corroboration/authorized visual judgment,provenance; perimeter/priority changes trigger assignment review. North Lookout Camera Mast sends snippet/bearing/confidence; South Lookout Camera Mast supplies independent bearing/Camera Cleaning Log; both report health. Smoke Classifier Module supplies mask/likelihood/growth/obscuration,never sole commitment basis. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine(Lantern) compares reconnaissance/camera/weather; Ridge Shadow Mask adjusts confidence; exposure refresh requires valid reconnaissance/weather. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node(Brindle) supplies Wind Shift Bulletin/probability-bands/exposure flags,caches weather. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock(Kestrel): readiness/health/recovery-gated release,Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Tasking Service creates approved,lane-avoiding missions; degraded-release requires County Emergency Liaison's Drone Corridor Permit. Drone Pilot Operator checks safety/endurance/noninterference. Air Attack Supervisor(Redtail) authorizes/deconflicts; Airspace Restricted State blocks dispatch pending route/altitude acceptance. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console(Marigold): availability/arrival/turnaround/priority. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater; Badger(full-name-unspecified) buffers acknowledgments≥15min,forwards after outage. Crewline Mobile Tablet encrypts queues/preserves provenance. Disconnected: cached review,last-sync,queued updates,no irreversible releases; repository outage: approved configuration only. Security: named accounts,RBAC,MFA,expiring signed offline credentials/supervisor review,least privilege,separate administrative approval,append-only audits,policy retention/encryption/controlled exports/deletion. Multi-period supplies/recovery,single-fault resilience; mandatory supervised qualification,annual refresh,prepeak tabletop,seasonal live exercises when feasible. Deployment governance board includes operational/maintenance/security/detection/aviation/ground-crew/county representatives; seasonal approval reviews residual risk,staffing,baselines,prior corrective actions. Acceptance: Portal/Analytics/Classifier documented mission tests; masts/weather availability,timing,quality; tasking/dock seasonal field

New part:
S239: Each after-action review shall reconstruct the timeline from system logs, user accounts, communications records, and maintenance notes without assigning blame to individual operators.
S240: Review facilitators shall document what was expected to happen, what actually happened, why differences occurred, and which corrective actions are necessary before the next readiness cycle.
S241: Corrective actions shall be entered into a controlled improvement backlog with assigned ownership, target completion dates, verification methods, and linkage to the originating event.
S242: Data stewardship shall define retention, access control, quality review, and disposition rules for operational records, sensor data, model outputs, configuration records, and user activity records.
S243: Operational data used for model evaluation shall be protected from unauthorized alteration and shall preserve enough context to support later engineering review and regulatory inquiry.
S244: Changes to the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine or Smoke Classifier Module shall be evaluated with representative seasonal data before deployment to confirm that detection performance improves without unacceptable increases in false alerts.
S245: Configuration changes to field equipment shall be versioned, reviewed, and tested in a nonoperational environment before being promoted into the seasonal baseline.
S246: At the end of each fire season, the governance board shall compare system performance, operational workload, maintenance burden, and user feedback against the acceptance criteria approved for that season.
S247: The resulting improvement plan shall define which procedures, training materials, interfaces, algorithms, and support arrangements will be revised before the next seasonal readiness campaign begins.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
